item.title: UK judge has been elected to ICJ for first time in a decade
item.body: A UK judge has been elected to the International Court of Justice for the first time in a decade. The campaign to secure his election began under Sir Keir Starmer's premiership and was backed by Andy Burnham.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | ⚖️ UK judge has been elected to ICJ for first time in a decade

A UK judge has been elected to the International Court of Justice for the first time in a decade. The campaign to secure his election began under Sir Keir Starmer's premiership and was backed by Andy Burnham.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 4 November, 09:50
